name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Fixes friends' titles failing to play in the browser when the friend converts them: a friend behind some proxies or tunnels wrote http addresses into its playlists, which a browser on an https page refuses. Your server now puts those addresses on the https address it already uses for that friend. Only your server needs 0.0.192 for this; the friend can stay on 0.0.187 or later. Also includes 0.0.191: a friend's title plays only from that friend while it converts for you.
